info.name: Oremus AI — Full API Collection
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Oremus AI backend (api.oremusai.vensframe.com).

Base URL: https://api.oremusai.vensframe.com

Authentication:
• Most endpoints require a JWT Bearer token.
• Login first via POST /api/auth/login, then set the {{token}} variable.
• Admin endpoints use X-Client-Id header to switch between clients.

Supported Platforms: Zoho Books, Xero, QuickBooks Online.

Folders:
1. Health — Server health check
2. Auth — Login, password reset, OAuth flows (Zoho/QBO/Xero)
3. Dashboard — KPIs, trends, charts
4. Metrics — Revenue, profitability, cashflow metrics
5. Ratios — Financial ratio calculations
6. Reports — Provider-agnostic report facade
7. ZB Reports — Full report library (P&L, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance, etc.)
8. Report Export — Download reports as XLSX or PDF
9. Accounting — GL ledger, accounts, journal entries
10. Analytics — ETL rebuilds and analytics dashboards
11. Customers — Customer listing
12. Vendors — Vendor listing
13. Transactions — Invoice/bill/expense/bank/account-transaction listings
14. Day Book — Day book view
15. Clients (Admin) — Client CRUD and provider connections
16. Search — Global search
17. Sync — Data sync for all platforms
18. ZB Warehouse — Zoho Books warehouse sync
19. QB Warehouse — QuickBooks warehouse sync
20. Provider Accounts — Platform-specific account summaries
21. Webhooks — Provider webhook receivers
22. Notifications — User notifications
